_doc: Committed dev-server baseline for scripts/perf/devbench.mjs. Keyed by VARIANT (warm/cold, +burst), not by run label. A run more than `tolerance` worse than its entry exits non-zero. Move a number with `node scripts/perf/devbench.mjs <label> --record`, and review the diff — that is the whole ratchet.
_provenance: Seeded by transcription from the dated measurement table in docs/architecture/app-structure.md § 'Dev compile cost' (measured 2026-08-07 with this same tool, win32, next@16.3.0-canary). They are the only durable dev-server numbers this repo had, which is precisely the problem the baseline file exists to fix: the tool appended to a gitignored .next/devbench.jsonl that every --cold run wiped. Treat them as the starting ratchet, not as gospel — the first `--record` on a machine supersedes them with a measurement rather than a transcription, and `tolerance` is wide enough that the transcription cannot fail an honest run.
